task: Leg 15: attribute the 7.5e-7 T+R=1 closure residual of the non-empty (open-domain, PML-walled) slab fixture, by a controlled ladder over the knobs the four hypotheses name, plus one null case and one negative control.
input_basis: The fixture, slab index, ppw, duration and transverse cells are leg 3's (configs/leg3-analytic-cases.json). Every knob below is a declared arithmetic or numerical setting, never a device input: pml_cells 32 and interior half-length 4.0 um are parity.project_for's own values and are the baseline; the ladders move one knob at a time. Slab index 1.0 is a null (no interface). The lossy material is leg 12's control material, reused verbatim.

hypotheses.H1: a boundary echo (PML reflection) sits inside the DFT window and pollutes both ratios; killed by letting pml_cells, interior_half_um or slab_center_um move it
hypotheses.H2: unapodized finite-window DFT leakage; killed by letting duration_fs or frequency_points move it
hypotheses.H3: the residual is intrinsic to the R extraction, which forms the flux of a DIFFERENCE field; killed if the archived decomposition in checks/test_leg15_closure.py shows the gap sits exactly there and does not move with any knob
hypotheses.H4: the staircase interface loses energy at the grid scale; killed by the index-1.0 null (no interface) and by the ppw scaling leg 4 already measured

negative_control.expect: energy_residual of order 3.4e-01, i.e. at least 10^4 times the effect under test; measured 3.4032e-01 in leg 12

wavelength_um.normalisation: none needed: this is the axis, not a measured quantity

R.plane: reflection monitor, normal x, at x = -2 micrometres (snapped)
R.span: full periodic transverse width of the monitor
R.normalisation: minus the flux of (sample field minus reference field) divided by the absolute empty-run flux through the same monitor, per frequency (the solver's normalize_flux, subtract_incident=True)

T.plane: transmission monitor, normal x, at x = +2 micrometres (snapped)
T.span: full periodic transverse width of the monitor
T.normalisation: signed sample-run flux divided by the absolute empty-run flux through the same monitor, per frequency (the solver's normalize_flux, no incident subtraction)

energy_residual.span: the union of the two monitor spans
energy_residual.normalisation: max |R + T - 1| over the sampled band; the quantity this leg attributes

absolute_change.normalisation: max over the band of |R_stored_flux - (1 - net_flux/reference_flux)|: the gap between the two ways of composing R from the same stored arrays, i.e. the decomposition behind H3

relative_change.plane: the empty-run reflection and transmission monitors
relative_change.normalisation: max over the band of |flux_empty_reflection / flux_empty_transmission - 1|: how far the two denominators differ, i.e. the emptiness of the incident side

empty_reflection_floor.plane: scattered monitor, normal x, at x = -3 micrometres, empty run
empty_reflection_floor.span: full periodic transverse width of the monitor
empty_reflection_floor.normalisation: max over the band of |empty-run scattered-monitor flux| divided by |empty-run reflection-monitor flux|; the echo detector

stop_conditions: if the answer needs a change to the solver fork, stop and ask
if two mechanisms move together and cannot be separated, report both and stop; do not declare one from correlation alone

dropped.why: geometry_assertions refused it: at slab centre +1.5 um the staircase-realised thickness differs from the physical 0.6 um, so the case would not be the same fixture. Dropped, not approximated (stop condition 1 pattern).
